title: Member search is clamped server-side to the advertised maximum of 500, whatever limit the caller sends

criteria.given: an authenticated caller searching the 10k-member FoodMart Customers.Name level with limit=2000000000
criteria.then: the server returns at most 500 members (the advertised schema maximum), not the whole level

criteria.given: the same search with a small limit
criteria.then: the limit is still honoured, so the clamp narrows nothing a legitimate caller relied on

steps.name: an enormous limit is clamped to 500 members
a small limit is still honoured
